messages:
marina_ops: Heads up — inbound H100 batch (PO 12345) scanned at FRA but manifest qty is 8 vs expected 10. Two serials missing from manifest, customs flagged, holding shipment.
ops-bot: Inbound shipment 2026-03-12 09:22 UTC: AWB XX12345 — status: Held (Customs) — docs requested.
devon_procure: @marina_ops can you paste the manifest lines? Need serials to match before we talk RMA.
marina_ops: pasted manifest snippet:
```
AWB: XX12345
SKU: H100-80GB
Expected QTY: 10
Manifest QTY: 8
Serials on manifest: SNL001,SNL002,SNL003,SNL004,SNL005,SNL006,SNL007,SNL008
Missing: SNL009,SNL010 (were allocated to us in the PO)
```
sophie_logistics: customs asking for EORI + commercial invoice copy. I'll send now. If vendor confirms DOA/DOO we can trigger RMA but customs will delay.
josh_vendor: Sorry — we see two units flagged at origin as 'unconfirmed serials' — likely held for export paperwork. We can either (A) reissue AWB with corrected manifest (ETA +48h) or (B) de-scan and RMA from vendor stock (lead time 7-10 days) or (C) provide 2 loaner H100s from our EU pool for 14 days while docs clear (fee applies). Which do you prefer?
devon_procure: Option A if it's just paperwork — lower cost. What's the risk of missing serials showing up later? customs can release in 24-72h if paperwork ok.
marina_ops: Risk is we need capacity in EU pool tonight for scheduled canary runs. If delayed, will degrade SLA for dedicated customers.
josh_vendor: We can do temporary loaners same-day dispatch if you accept deposit and return label. ETA to FRA depot 10-12h. We'll invoice shipping.
devon_procure: Cost for loaners? (ballpark)
josh_vendor: Loaner fee $2k/unit/day + return shipping. Deposit refundable on return and passing inspection.
sophie_logistics: Also note customs might charge storage if held >48h. Ops-bot: add to cost tracker? -> reaction :receipt: 
ops-bot: Action created: #A-657 — temp-loaners vs re-manifest decision. Owner: devon_procure. Due: 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC.
marina_ops: Quick check — can we burn compute from our US pool instead? Region constraints: customers in EU need low latency, so US won't work.
devon_procure: Okay plan: try A (re-manifest). If not cleared by 14:00 UTC, accept loaners. @josh_vendor send proforma for loaner deposit and label.
josh_vendor: Will send proforma now. Also sending manifest amendment template. Attaching customs code HS:8473.30.
marina_ops: please cc customs broker. I'll also take photos of pallets once we get depot access.
sophie_logistics: If re-manifest fails, what's the RMA lead if units are actually missing/lost? We need replacement ETA.
josh_vendor: RMA replacement lead time 7-10 business days from claim approval. If warranty covers shipping we can expedite; otherwise cost goes to procurement.
devon_procure: Noted. set reminder 14:05 UTC for decisions.
marina_ops: Thanks. tagging ops on-call for any cluster impact: @ethan_fw please be on standby — we may shift traffic.
ethan_fw: On it. I'll prep capacity scripts and a manual routing plan. Snippet:
```
kubectl cordon node-h100-3
kubectl scale deployment/ffmpeg --replicas=+2
```
marina_ops: update — customs released docs at 13:42 UTC, manifest corrected; two units found in origin hold and inbound now shows 10. Closing A-657. :tada: 
devon_procure: Great, cancel loaners. @josh_vendor thanks for rapid responses.
josh_vendor: Glad it's resolved. We'll update the invoice hold. Please send photos when available.
